hook: A 13.46‑meter TBM bored a 4.5‑km tunnel beneath the Panama Canal.

sections.voiceover: A 13.46‑meter TBM bored a 4.5‑km tunnel beneath the Panama Canal.
sections.visual_cue: Show the massive TBM cutterhead and a map of the Panama Canal tunnel route.

sections.voiceover: On 26 Oct 2026 the Herrenknecht TBM “Panamá” finished a 4.5 km drive from Farfán to Albrook. What does this length mean for Panama Canal engineering?
sections.visual_cue: Display a timeline of the drive, the cutterhead size graphic, and a question overlay over the canal map.

sections.voiceover: But the tunnel’s sheer size also forced new safety protocols.
sections.visual_cue: Show engineers reviewing safety plans beside the tunnel cross‑section.

sections.voiceover: The 4.5 km bore marked the first tunnel under the Panama Canal. Engineers now cite the Panama Metro Line 3 tunnel as the new benchmark.
sections.visual_cue: Show breakthrough footage, the cutterhead in action, and a graphic comparing the Line 3 tunnel to other projects.

sections.voiceover: A 13.46‑meter cutterhead reshaped canal tunneling forever.
sections.visual_cue: Close on the TBM’s cutterhead rotating underground.
